title: The Man Who Survived Two Atomic Bombs
lines: He survived the atomic bomb on Hiroshima. | Three days later, he was in Nagasaki.
August sixth, {1945~nineteen forty-five}. | Tsutomu Yamaguchi, an engineer, is on a business trip to Hiroshima.
At eight fifteen, the bomb explodes about three kilometres away. | His eardrums burst, his skin is burned, | but he survives.
The next day, wounded, he takes the train home. | Home is Nagasaki.
August ninth. | Bandaged, he goes back to work, | and tells his boss about the blinding flash in Hiroshima.
That's when it happens again. | Another flash, about three kilometres away.
He survives that one too. | Japan only officially recognised him as a survivor of both bombs in {2009~two thousand nine}. | He lived to ninety-three.
Luckiest or unluckiest man in history? | Tell me in the comments.
